deviations_from_card: Added examples/ledgerbox/components/lanes/card/acts.ts (one coupled file, 2 lines): since the card was written the Send issue moved from Decide.tsx:283 into acts.ts actSpecs, so the draft id rides ActIssue there and Decide's perform passes it. Rode as one commit, not three. The existing stale-send test in ledgerbox-app-shell.test.ts now expects 'redrafted, not sent' instead of 'Draft it again'. The ADR 0203 undo refusal for a deleted draft now says 'replaced by a later one' (dropped 'when it was sent', since a redraft also replaces). Redraft ids get an '_r' suffix so a same-millisecond redraft can never share the stale draft's id (which its undo row would then reach).
